parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Using a simple kinetic model of matter, describe the structure of a solid.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The specific latent heat of vaporisation is much greater than the specific latent heat of fusion for the same substance.
Explain this, in terms of the spacing of molecules.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Determine the temperature at which the substance melts.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
The power of the heater is $150\text{ W}$.
Use data from Fig. 3.1 to calculate, in $\text{kJ kg}^{-1}$, the specific latent heat of vaporisation $L$ of the substance.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Suggest what can be deduced from the fact that section $\mathbf{Q}$ on the graph is less steep than section $\mathbf{P}$.
